title: Broad and Efficient PII Detection with Unified Labels
abstract: arXiv:2610.22597v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Personally Identifiable Information (PII) detection models must efficiently find identifiers across diverse contexts while maintaining a low false-positive rate (FPR) on high-volume traffic. Recent detectors increasingly rely on complex architectures that raise deployment cost, yet many are fine-tuned on only a few synthetic datasets that limit their coverage. Combining public datasets is challenging because their taxonomies differ, and even after categories are mapped to a common schema, labels can disagree on what counts as a detection, producing inconsistent training and evaluation signals. To address these problems, we present a practical 141M-parameter encoder-based detector trained on 1.12 million examples from 77 public datasets, relabeled under a detailed definition of broad contextual detection for 12 structured PII categories. translated_title: 基于统一标签的广泛且高效的个人身份信息检测
translated_abstract: 个人身份信息（PII）检测模型必须在多样化上下文中高效识别标识符，同时在大流量环境下保持低误报率（FPR）。近期的检测器越来越依赖会推高部署成本的复杂架构，然而许多模型仅在少数合成数据集上进行微调，限制了其覆盖范围。合并公开数据集颇具挑战性，因为各数据集的分类体系不同，即使将类别映射到统一模式后，标签在什么构成一次检测上仍可能存在分歧，从而产生不一致的训练与评估信号。为解决这些问题，我们提出了一种实用的141M参数基于编码器的检测器，该检测器在来自77个公开数据集的112万个样本上训练，样本根据针对12类结构化PII类别的广义上下文检测的详细定义进行了重新标注。在AI4Privacy和Nemotron-PII基准上于低误报率工作点进行评估，我们的模型取得了……
tldr: 该论文通过对77个公开数据集在统一标签体系下重新标注，训练出一个141M参数的高效编码器检测器，实现了对12类结构化PII在低误报率下的广泛且高效的检测。
en_tdlr: The paper presents a practical 141M-parameter encoder-based PII detector trained on 1.12M examples from 77 public datasets relabeled under unified labels, achieving broad and efficient detection of 12 structured PII categories at a low false-positive rate.
